area: comms, omnichain, sdk, scripts, deployments, docs (+ web renderer, GitHub Pages UI, machine-discovery files, and the unmerged Commons/Utility branches that bear on website delivery, social, launchpad and vault)
summary:
ANIMA's 'reach' layer in this area is three things. AgentComms (7,368 B) is a deliberately narrow messaging contract: a sender proves control of an agent id, escrows the recipient's self-set postage in an ERC-20, and the recipient collects it only by replying within a 5-minute-to-30-day window, otherwise anyone can refund the sender; payload bytes never touch the chain (only keccak commitment + transport URI), sendPrivate/replyPrivate pin the exact recipient encryption key from a chain-wide EncryptionKeyRegistry so a mempool rotation fails the send, and senders supply maxPostage/expectedFeeToken to stop a recipient front-running its own price. Its gap for the merge goal is enumeration: _nextMessageId is private and there is no per-agent or per-thread index, so an indexer-free on-chain UI cannot list an inbox. The omnichain layer (AnimaOApp + OmniAgentHome + OmniAgentMirror + codec) is a LayerZero V2 escrow-never-burn bridge: the home token is escrowed, a snapshot of manifest hash, brain root/epoch, weights root, seal policy and home identity crosses the wire, the mirror is a plain ERC-721 that answers isReplica()==true, carries no bond or account, has exactly one home route, and can only be sent home; inbound messages require msg.sender==endpoint AND a registered non-zero peer, with an opt-in per-source rate limiter. It round-tripped for real on four testnet routes; one Unichain packet has been stuck since 2026-08-31 and the project admits there is no recovery state machine and no explicit DVN configuration.

The SDK (sdk/src/index.ts, 772 lines) is the reference implementation of every off-chain commitment the contracts make and is tested byte-for-byte against Solidity: RFC 8785 manifest canonicalisation and hash, ordered brain-root hash chain, InferenceMeter work root, audit-log replay, private-envelope commitment, EIP-712 order/voucher types, the derived EIP-2535 cut for the immutable diamond (throws on any unrouted/duplicate/extra selector), and LayerZero Type-3 executor options pinned to the Solidity builder's bytes because the mock endpoint silently accepted 0x. The scripts are a mature live-chain harness (resumable records keyed by deployer, wait-for-code, ids from receipt logs, block until the endpoint reaches the tx block, twelve-wallet adversarial towns with mined reverts as evidence, a star LayerZero exerciser that treats saved state as evidence not authority) and deploy-diamond.ts verifies the deployed diamond against its ABI on chain before printing an address. Deployment records cover Base Sepolia (two deployments, both with destroyed or disclosed keys), Sepolia, Unichain Sepolia (non-canonical ERC-6551 registry), Robinhood and BSC testnets: 60 agents, 991 receipts.

Website delivery is the weak point relative to the goal. On main there are two UIs: a GitHub-Pages Vite 'Sanctuary' (off-chain, hardcoded to a different token address than the README advertises, with fictional showcase data, but with a reusable client-side ownerOf sweep for 'which agents does this wallet hold' and a self-contained data: JSON+SVG tokenURI at mint) and AnimaWeb3Renderer, an ERC-4804 manual-mode contract (22,592 B, 1,984 B under EIP-170) whose fallback(bytes path) builds the whole console HTML for /token/{id}/live in a view call, served via web3:// or w3link gateways. That page imports viem from esm.sh, hardcodes public RPCs for two chains, mislabels the seal policy enum, and gates nothing by holder: anyone sees the page; writes are only refused by the contracts themselves via simulateContract. Two unmerged branches hold the pieces the goal actually needs: AnimaCommons (12,941 B on-chain social circles with 1,024-byte bodies, paged arrays, moderation tombstones, a history hash chain, work-request-to-escrow links and an agent badge gated on isController plus an exact ERC-5646 fingerprint), FrozenClient/ClientPart (a 609 KB HTML bundle stored as inert code parts with a keccak commitment checked in the constructor, pinned to the NFT via an owner-mutable setMetadata key, 135.9M gas locally), TimeLockVault (admin-less fixed-beneficiary locks, native or exact ERC-20) and V2LiquidityDeployer plus 'checked' launchpad entrypoints that pin fees, deployer and deadline into the call. That branch ships its source as an opaque xz patch applied by CI; I decompressed it and verified the pinned hashes before reading it.

components.name: AgentComms
components.purpose: Priced, identity-authenticated agent messaging: postage escrowed on send, collectable only by replying, refundable if ignored; commitment + transport URI on chain, ciphertext off chain; key-pinned private envelopes; authenticated broadcasts.
key_functions: configureInbox(uint256 agentId, address feeToken, uint128 postage, uint64 replyWindow, bool open) — owner only; window 5 min..30 days
setSenderAllowed(uint256,address,bool) / setAgentSenderAllowed(uint256,uint256,bool) — owner only; agent-id allowlist survives key rotation
send(uint256 toAgentId, uint256 fromAgentId, bytes32 threadId, bytes32 payloadHash, string transportURI, address expectedFeeToken, uint128 maxPostage) returns (uint256 messageId)
sendPrivate(..., bytes32 expectedRecipientKeyId) — requires keyIdOf(ownerOf(toAgentId)) == expected
reply(uint256 messageId, bytes32 payloadHash, string transportURI) — any controller of toAgentId; postage paid to accountOf(toAgentId)
replyPrivate(uint256, bytes32, string, bytes32 expectedRecipientKeyId) — pins original sender's key
broadcast(uint256 fromAgentId, bytes32 topic, bytes32 payloadHash, string transportURI) — controller only, event only
design_decisions: Only the parts of messaging that need a chain: authenticated identity, priced attention with refund, commitment not content (L28-47).
maxPostage + expectedFeeToken guard against a recipient raising postage in front of a pending send (L203-206; regression test).
Allowlists keyed by agent id because agents rotate session keys (L183-184).
Postage goes to the agent's ERC-6551 account, never the caller (L302-303).
sendPrivate/replyPrivate pin the exact registry key so a mempool rotation fails instead of recording undecryptable ciphertext (L222-223); zero in recipientKeyOf means legacy path.
Ordering/delivery guarantees explicitly refused as the transport's job.
security_invariants: A message is answered XOR refunded; late reply reverts even before refund is claimed
Writing as an agent requires isController, which a sale revokes (operatorEpoch roll)
Value-conserving ERC-20 transfers (ExactERC20) — fee-on-transfer tokens revert
standards: relies on ERC-721 ownerOf and ERC-6551 accountOf
components.reuse_notes: Keep escrow/refund/identity/key-pinning verbatim. Add nextMessageId() getter, per-agent and per-thread id arrays with paged views, optional bounded on-chain body, optional native postage. Decide whether operators need their own pinned keys (today the owner's key is pinned).

components.name: EncryptionKeyRegistry
components.purpose: Chain-wide singleton where an address publishes the public key sealed content must be encrypted to; keyType names the scheme (X25519=1, secp256k1 ECIES=2, P-256=3, ML-KEM-768=4).
design_decisions: A key belongs to a person, not a collection (L15-18)
Revocation makes sealed transfers revert rather than deliver unopenable ciphertext (L50-52)
components.reuse_notes: 1,783 B; no owner; exactly the primitive a private-messaging layer needs.

components.name: ILayerZeroV2
components.purpose: Hand-transcribed minimal LayerZero V2 endpoint/receiver ABI (MessagingParams, MessagingReceipt, MessagingFee, Origin; quote/send/setDelegate/eid; allowInitializePath/nextNonce/lzReceive) kept local so the build is hermetic.
components.reuse_notes: Only needed if the merged protocol keeps a LayerZero bridge.

components.name: AnimaOmniCodec / AgentSnapshot
components.purpose: abi.encode/decode of AgentSnapshot {to, agentId, brainRoot, brainEpoch, manifestHash, weightsRoot, seal, homeChainId, homeToken, agentURI} — what crosses the wire so a mirror is a verifiable replica.
design_decisions: Plain abi.encode deliberately; hand-packed codecs 'have produced a remarkable number of critical bugs' and length-prefixing makes truncation fail loudly (L27-30)
components.reuse_notes: Adapt the struct fields to the merged token's state; never add ciphertext or keys (PRIVACY.md).

components.name: AnimaOApp
components.purpose: Abstract OApp base: owner-set peers per eid, dual authentication (msg.sender==endpoint AND registered non-zero peer), opt-in per-source-chain inbound rate limit, unordered delivery, outbound send/quote with exact-fee check.
key_functions: setInboundLimit(uint32 srcEid, uint64 windowSeconds, uint64 capacity) onlyOwner
design_decisions: Every inbound message must satisfy both halves; zero peer never trusted, unset route fails closed (L18-29)
Rate limit converts a forged-DVN drain into a retryable delay; off by default so a deployment picks a number (L43-51, L84-85)
Unordered nonce so one stuck message cannot block a route (L131-132)
Security rests on DVN/executor config at the endpoint, not here (L31-35)
components.reuse_notes: Keep auth + rate limit; reconsider having an owner at all (IPSEITY's port has none and pins config at construction).

components.name: OmniAgentHome
components.purpose: Home-chain escrow: send() validates receiver word, owner, not-locked, native balance acknowledgement, snapshots agent state, records awayOn[agentId]=dstEid, transfers token into itself (tripping the pause-on-transfer hook), dispatches; _lzReceive releases only an agent that left, only from the chain it went to.
key_functions: quoteSend(uint32 dstEid, bytes32 to, uint256 agentId, bytes options) view returns (MessagingFee)
send(uint32 dstEid, bytes32 to, uint256 agentId, bytes options, MessagingFee fee, address refundAddress, bool acknowledgeAssetsRemain) payable returns (MessagingReceipt)
design_decisions: Escrow, never burn: bond/reputation are chain-local claims (L27-32)
Mirror has a different ERC-6551 account; ERC-20s cannot be enumerated so are not checked; departure event publishes the account for front-ends (L34-41)
Busy agent may not leave (L43-45)
Right-padded receiver would strand the token forever — validated before escrow (L104-107)
components.reuse_notes: Optional for a single-chain goal; correct shape if multi-chain presence is wanted. Needs a packet-recovery policy before production.

components.name: OmniAgentMirror
components.purpose: Remote ERC-721 replica minted on arrival and burned on departure; stores Replica{brainRoot, manifestHash, weightsRoot, brainEpoch, homeChainId, syncedAt, seal, homeEid, homeToken, agentURI}; verifyManifest(bytes) checks keccak against the committed hash; isReplica() always true; exactly one home route; send() is home-only.
key_functions: quoteSend / send(uint32 dstEid, bytes32 to, uint256 agentId, bytes options, MessagingFee fee, address refundAddress)
design_decisions: A mirror is not the agent: no bond, no reputation, no account, says so via isReplica (L17-21)
Honest staleness via syncedAt (L28-30)
Second home route rejected at config time, not after escrow (L71-73)
Forwarding chain-to-chain would strand the original (L150-154)
components.reuse_notes: Same as home; drop if no bridge.

components.name: MockLZEndpoint
components.purpose: Queue-and-deliver LayerZero mock with spoofable origin sender; deliberately does not auto-deliver so replay/reorder cases are testable.
components.reuse_notes: Remember it accepts empty options; always build real Type-3 options.

components.name: ANIMA SDK
components.purpose: Reference implementation of every off-chain hashing rule plus manifest typing/verification, EIP-712 types, policy helpers, immutable-diamond cut derivation and LayerZero options.
key_functions: verifyManifestBytes / fetchVerifiedManifest (HTTPS, 1 MiB, 10 s, no redirects)
shardLeaf / brainRoot (ordered hash chain, tags anima.BrainShard.v1 / anima.BrainRoot.v1)
deriveFacetCut({tokenAbi, base, specialised, additional}) / cutIsImmutable / DIAMOND_CUT_SELECTOR 0x1f931c1c
design_decisions: Hash first, parse second (L258-262)
JCS chosen because A2A signs JCS; JSON.stringify is JCS-conformant except NaN/Infinity and lone surrogates, which throw (L351-358)
deriveFacetCut computes the cut from the ABI because hand-written selector lists are the standing hazard of immutable diamonds (L662-677)
lzReceiveOptions pinned to Solidity bytes in tests (L759-760)
components.reuse_notes: Hashing/cut/options verbatim; adapt the manifest layer so web3:// and on-chain manifests are first-class and HTTPS is only a mirror.

components.name: deploy-diamond.ts
components.purpose: Deploys four facets + initialiser, derives the cut with the SDK, deploys the immutable diamond, then verifies on chain: every ABI selector routes to its assigned facet, no diamondCut, loupe lists exactly the facets, facet code matches artifacts with immutables masked, config hash matches, init took effect, ERC-165 correct.
design_decisions: waitForCode against public-RPC lag (L51-68)
maskImmutables for honest bytecode comparison (L42-49)
Fails with 'do NOT publish this address'
components.reuse_notes: Run for real by test/Deploy.test.ts. Keep if the merged token is a diamond.

components.name: deploy.ts / testnet-deploy.ts
components.purpose: Monolith and resumable live deployment with per-chain JSON records keyed by deployer, canonical ERC-6551 detection, EntryPoint v0.7 detection, cast keys outside the repo, wiring journal.
design_decisions: Wiring is the security-critical step; nothing enters allowlists that was not deployed here
Records belonging to another key are never reused
PAYMENT_PROCESSOR must be a dedicated non-deployer address
components.reuse_notes: Keep the resumable-record and lag-defence patterns as a shared helper.

components.name: Live-chain exercisers
components.path: scripts/testnet-scenario.ts, testnet-modules.ts, testnet-everything*.ts, testnet-omni.ts, testnet-omni-status.ts, testnet-mint.ts, testnet-batch-mint.ts, testnet-batch-exercise.ts, testnet-town.ts
components.purpose: Drive the protocol on real testnets with explorer links for every tx; twelve-wallet adversarial towns mine attack reverts as evidence; the LayerZero star runner resumes journeys from on-chain custody and refuses duplicate sends.
design_decisions: State is evidence, not authority
Ids from receipt logs; block until endpoint reaches tx block; single transport
Explicit gas so negative assertions produce status-0 receipts
components.reuse_notes: Generic harness worth porting; replace feature acts with the merged protocol's.

components.name: economy-sim.mjs
components.purpose: Seeded Monte Carlo stress model (4 policies x 4 worlds x 250 runs x 180 days) with a value-conservation assertion; output docs/ECONOMY_SIMULATION.json.
components.reuse_notes: Research artefact, not protocol; keep only as a reference if economics are revisited.

components.name: generate-agent-function-index.mjs + public discovery files
components.purpose: Machine discovery: ABI-derived index of 29 contracts / 657 functions with selectors; a well-known directory with chain, contracts, standards, renderer URL templates and safety rules; JSON Schemas for manifest and directory, tested by ManifestSchema.test.mjs.
components.reuse_notes: Cheap and useful for agent-facing discovery; regenerate against the merged ABI.

components.name: AnimaWeb3Renderer
components.purpose: ERC-4804 manual-mode contract: resolveMode()='manual'; fallback(bytes path) returns abi.encode(string html) for '/', '/token/{id}/live' and not-found; builds the full agent console HTML/CSS/JS in a view call with owner, ERC-6551 account and collection interpolated.
design_decisions: Separate from the immutable token so an existing collection gains a browser without changing token logic (L14-16)
Stateless, ownerless, redeployable by anyone (deploy-web3-renderer.ts L36-37)
security_invariants: Only addresses/ids are interpolated, so no HTML injection surface
components.reuse_notes: Keep the manual-mode routing skeleton and the three-tab console structure. Must: inline the JS (no esm.sh), stop hardcoding RPCs (use the gateway's/wallet's provider), fix the seal enum labels, gate the control surface by ownerOf/isController, and move the page body into SSTORE2-style shards because only 1,984 B of EIP-170 headroom remain.

components.name: GitHub Pages Sanctuary
components.purpose: Off-chain Vite site: marketing landing with fictional beings, plus an owner portal that connects a wallet, sweeps totalMinted()/ownerOf() to list held agents, mints with a self-contained data: JSON+SVG tokenURI, deploys the ERC-6551 account, toggles status, and asks the wallet to watch the ERC-721.
design_decisions: Metadata stored with the token so Brave renders it without a server (L147-148)
Relative asset URLs so the same build works on localhost, IPFS and GitHub Pages (vite.config.js)
components.reuse_notes: Not on-chain; points at a different token than the README; fake showcase numbers. Salvage the data:-URI metadata idea and the ownership-sweep UX.

components.name: cli/anima.mjs (ENS binding terminal)
components.purpose: Interactive CLI that verifies isController on the agent chain, then atomically writes ENS resolver records (addr = agent account, text com.anima.agent = eip155:chain:contract:id, com.anima.account, url, contenthash from a CIDv1 ipfs:// URI) and optionally transfers custody of the .eth to the agent's ERC-6551 account (mainnet only; wrapped and unwrapped paths).
components.reuse_notes: Good pattern for giving an NFT a human-readable web name; extend contenthash to a web3:// / on-chain pointer rather than IPFS only.

components.name: Deployment records
components.purpose: Machine-written evidence of what was deployed and exercised: contracts, cast, wiring journal, smoke, extended, townRun evidence (tx hashes + status), batchMint/batchExercise, omni journeys.
components.reuse_notes: Historical: deployer keys destroyed (0xb76d) or compromised by disclosure (0xc591). Keep the record format and the evidence.

components.name: docs/ (ARCHITECTURE, SPEC, SECURITY, PRIVACY, DEPLOYMENT, AGENT_*, research and audits)
components.purpose: Design rationale with measured numbers, 39 security invariants, draft ERC, privacy boundaries, deployment order, agent integration guide, standards census, microeconomy research, dated testnet audits.
components.reuse_notes: Reuse the invariant lists, the 'honest limitations' style and the trust-boundary table; correct the drifting test counts and token addresses.

components.name: test/helpers.ts
components.purpose: deployProtocol() fixture that swaps monolith/diamond via ANIMA_IMPL using the SDK's deriveFacetCut; mintAgent(); local brainRoot(); expectRevert() that matches error names OR any 4-byte selector of that name scanned from artifacts (needed for diamond reverts).
components.reuse_notes: The selector-aware expectRevert and the dual-build fixture are worth keeping.

components.name: AnimaCommons (unmerged branch upgrade/sanctuary-commons-3d-20260904)
components.purpose: On-chain public social layer: circles with stewards/moderators/invites/bans/slow mode, typed posts (Discussion/Question/WorkRequest/Update) with <=1,024-byte bodies stored on chain, paged id arrays (no indexer), revisions, withdraw/moderate tombstones, replacement-style reactions, accepted replies, work-request-to-WorkEscrow links requiring exact specHash and client match, a per-circle history hash chain, and an optional agent badge that requires isController(agentId) plus an exact current ERC-5646 fingerprint.
key_functions: publish(circleId, parentId, agentId, expectedAgentState, kind, body)
design_decisions: Wallet is the social principal; buying a token does not buy a human's posts or roles (L17-20)
Tombstones hide, never delete (L16-17)
Evidence-linked work cards, not self-asserted badges (L286)
No custody, no owner, 12,941 B, kept outside the token because the monolith has 605 B headroom
security_invariants: Fingerprint pin invalidates stale agent authorship across A->B->A transfers
Moderators cannot ban stewards or peers; leaving/ban clears dormant roles
Byte limits, slow mode on publish and revise
components.reuse_notes: Closest existing match for an indexer-free messaging/social layer. Decide NFT-gated vs wallet-principal participation; 29 tests exist; not deployed publicly.

components.name: FrozenClient / ClientPart (unmerged branch fix/utility-workflows-20260904, inside xz patch)
components.purpose: SSTORE2-style immutable HTML publication: ClientPart stores <=23,000 bytes behind a leading STOP; FrozenClient(address[] parts, bytes32 expectedHash) validates <=128 parts, prefix and sizes, reassembles via extcodecopy and reverts unless keccak256 matches; html()/readPart()/partCount() views. utility-publish.mjs pins abi.encode(client, hash) under the NFT's metadata key anima.client.v2; utility-recover.mjs rebuilds from eth_getCode and verifies before writing.
design_decisions: No proxy, mutable chunk registry, external resources or HTTP dependency
Pointer is owner-mutable; content immutable (SECURITY.md)
Publication deliberately restricted to chain 31337
components.reuse_notes: Measured 609,226 B bundle, 27 parts, 135,938,093 gas locally. Combine with the ERC-4804 renderer so tokenURI/web3:// serve the frozen bundle; make the pointer immutable or versioned rather than owner-mutable.

components.name: TimeLockVault (unmerged branch, xz patch)
components.purpose: Admin-less, non-yielding, fixed-beneficiary time locks for native or exact-transfer ERC-20; beneficiary may extend only; anyone may trigger claim at maturity; paged enumeration by beneficiary.
key_functions: createLock(address token, uint256 amount, address beneficiary, uint64 unlockAt) payable returns (uint256 id)
security_invariants: No cancellation, no beneficiary change, no early exit
Both sender and recipient deltas checked for ERC-20
components.reuse_notes: 3,632 B, 13 tests. A vault feature, not the whole 'vault' pillar (that is the ERC-6551 account plus a receive-only Grip).

components.name: V2LiquidityDeployer + AgentLaunchpad checked entrypoints (unmerged branch, xz patch)
components.purpose: ILiquidityDeployer adapter that adds V2 liquidity on graduation with 1% ratio tolerance, verifies the LP delta equals the router's declared amount, locks the LP in TimeLockVault to the beneficiary for 1-3650 days, returns dust and zeroes approvals. Launchpad gains UTILITY_API=1, createLaunchChecked(p, expectedDeployer, expectedFeeHash) and buyChecked/sellChecked(..., deadline, maxFeeBps).
components.reuse_notes: The 'checked' pattern (pin mutable governance config and deadlines into the call) should be adopted across swap/launch/vault.

standards_implemented: LayerZero V2 OApp receiver ABI (lzReceive, allowInitializePath, nextNonce, oAppVersion) — omni
EIP-712 typed data: AnimaMarket Order, AnimaInferenceMeter Voucher, AnimaAgent AgentWalletBinding (SDK/scripts)
EIP-2535 cut derivation and immutability check (SDK, deploy-diamond)
ERC-165 interface ids verified on chain (deploy-diamond)
Branch: ERC-5646 fingerprint pinning (AnimaCommons), SSTORE2-style code storage (FrozenClient), Uniswap V2 router interface (V2LiquidityDeployer)
unique_ideas: Postage escrow collectable only by replying, refundable by anyone after the window; sender-supplied maxPostage + expectedFeeToken defeat recipient front-running of its own price
Allowlist peers by agent id so session-key rotation never breaks correspondence

sendPrivate/replyPrivate pin the exact registry key id so a key rotation in the mempool fails the tx instead of recording undecryptable ciphertext; SDK privateEnvelopeHash domain-separates ciphertext by chain, contract, sender, recipient, key and nonce

Escrow-never-burn bridge carrying an AgentSnapshot so the mirror is a verifiable replica (verifyManifest) that answers isReplica()==true; awayOn bookkeeping; one home route per mirror; home-only return; right-padded receiver check before escrow; acknowledgeAssetsRemain friction; opt-in inbound rate limiter that throttles rather than drops

deriveFacetCut: derive an immutable diamond's selector table from the ABI and refuse partial cuts; deploy script verifies routing, immutability, masked bytecode, config hash, init and ERC-165 on chain before printing an address
lzReceiveOptions bytes pinned to the Solidity builder because the mock endpoint accepted 0x — 'the single most common way a bridge that works in tests fails on a live chain'
ERC-4804 manual-mode renderer kept separate from the immutable token so an existing collection gains a browser later; any funded key can redeploy it
Three public-RPC lag defences: wait for code, ids from receipt logs, block until the endpoint reaches the tx block
Resumable deployment records where saved state is evidence not authority; twelve-wallet adversarial towns that mine attack reverts (status-0 receipts) as evidence
Self-contained data:application/json + inline SVG tokenURI at mint so wallets need no server or IPFS
Machine discovery: /.well-known/anima.json, llms.txt, ABI-derived function index (657 functions), JSON Schemas with additionalProperties:false that reject executable fields

Branch: fingerprint-pinned agent badges on social posts; per-circle history hash chain; work-request-to-escrow links requiring exact specHash; tombstones not deletions; wallet as social principal so a sale does not buy a person's history
Branch: FrozenClient constructor refuses to deploy unless the reassembled bundle hashes to the expected value; NFT metadata key pin plus a recover script that never executes recovered bytes

Branch: client verifies every deployed contract's runtime hash with solc immutable ranges masked, audits diamond facet routing selector-by-selector, and uses epoch-invalidated re-simulated plans with atomic approve/act/revoke batches through the ERC-6551 account
Branch: 'checked' launchpad entrypoints that pin fee schedule, liquidity deployer, deadline and max fee into the call
ENS binding CLI that writes com.anima.agent / com.anima.account text records and can hand .eth custody to the agent's ERC-6551 account
weaknesses: AgentComms has no enumeration: _nextMessageId is private, no per-agent/thread index — an indexer-free on-chain UI cannot list an inbox without eth_getLogs
AgentComms payloads are off-chain by design; ERC-20 postage only; sendPrivate pins the token owner's key, not an operator's; zero-postage open inboxes are spammable

AnimaWeb3Renderer imports viem from esm.sh and hardcodes public RPCs for only two chains — not self-contained; seal-policy labels index a 6-value enum with a 3-entry array (Committed shows as SEALED TEE); no holder gating of the UI; 1,984 B of EIP-170 headroom left

No UI surface on main gates reads by NFT ownership; writes rely solely on contract reverts surfaced by simulateContract; the Pages site hardcodes a different token address (0xb3d9...) than the README (0x0aeb...)

Omni: no recovery/cancel state machine for accepted-but-undelivered packets (Unichain agent #4 stuck since 2026-08-31); scripts never set an explicit DVN/executor stack; ERC-20 balances not checked at departure; mirror has a different ERC-6551 address and no bond; Ownable2Step owner over peers
Deployments are historical: 0xb76d burner destroyed, 0xc591 key disclosed; Unichain Sepolia uses a non-canonical ERC-6551 registry
Test counts drift across docs (199/239/261/268/279/322/362); CI runs only the monolith suite
The utility branch ships its source as an opaque xz patch applied by a workflow that pushes with the GitHub token — unreviewed until applied
Commons/utility contracts exist only on unmerged branches, are local-chain tested, undeployed and unaudited; FrozenClient's NFT pin is owner-mutable; publication costs ~136M gas for a 609 KB bundle
Whole project unaudited; 39 invariants and an adversarial pass are not an audit
website_delivery: Three surfaces on main. (1) A GitHub-Pages Vite site (index.html, src/main.js) — entirely off-chain, bundles viem, loads Google Fonts, hardcodes ANIMA 0xb3d92c766e3cb356db381feb21958a9ebb974365 and https://sepolia.base.org, shows fictional beings; its owner portal is real but client-side. (2) AnimaWeb3Renderer (contracts/web, 22,592 B): an ERC-4804 manual-mode contract whose fallback(bytes path) returns abi.encode(string html) for /token/{id}/live, served through web3://0x9160bE4d...75cd:84532/token/{id}/live or https://<renderer>.basesep.w3link.io/...; the HTML/CSS are generated on chain in a view call but the page's <script type=module> imports viem from https://esm.sh/viem@2.55.19 and talks to hardcoded public RPCs, so it is not dependency-free. (3) The token's tokenURI is whatever agentURI the controller set (the Sanctuary mints a self-contained data: JSON+SVG). On the unmerged fix/utility-workflows-20260904 branch, FrozenClient/ClientPart store a complete 609 KB HTML bundle as inert code parts with a constructor-checked keccak commitment, pinned to the NFT via setMetadata('anima.client.v2', abi.encode(client, hash)) — local chain only, owner-mutable pointer. Nothing on any branch emits the client from tokenURI itself.
wallet_gating: Reads are never gated anywhere; every page and view is public. The ERC-4804 renderer shows the full console to anyone and only asks for a wallet when a write is attempted; authorization is enforced solely by the ANIMA/account/module contracts (ownerOf / isController / guardian / module allowlists) and surfaced to the user by simulateContract failing. The GitHub-Pages Sanctuary verifies holding client-side by reading totalMinted() and ownerOf(id) for every id and keeping those equal to the connected EIP-1193 address (no signature challenge). The unmerged utility client gates owner actions with ownerOnly(id) = ownerOf(id) == connected wallet, re-checks eth_accounts/eth_chainId before each send, and refuses to spend unless every deployed contract's runtime hash matches the compiled release. The only on-chain NFT-gated social action is AnimaCommons.publish on the Commons branch: posting with an agent badge requires ANIMA.isController(agentId, msg.sender) and an exact current getStateFingerprint(agentId); circle membership itself is wallet-based, deliberately not NFT-gated.

pitfalls: MockLZEndpoint accepts empty executor options; the real message library rejects 0x — always build with lzReceiveOptions()
Public RPC load balancers lag: wait for code before constructors inspect fresh deployments, take ids from receipt logs, block until the endpoint reaches the tx block
AgentCore/Lease field order is normative for the ERC-5646 fingerprint — append only
Every AnimaAgent function must be in exactly one facet; deriveFacetCut throws otherwise — do not loosen it
Never wrap optional side effects in try/catch on gas-estimated paths (eth_estimateGas finds the path where they fail)
A bare @ in NatSpec breaks compilation
Doc test counts drift; measure before quoting
The two published UIs point at different token addresses; both deployers' keys are gone or compromised; owner functions on 0x0aeb... are permanently unreachable
Renderer depends on esm.sh and hardcoded RPCs; chains other than 84532/11155111 get rpc=undefined; seal labels are wrong; only 1,984 B of bytecode headroom
AgentComms cannot be enumerated on chain; eth_getLogs over MessageSent is required today
Do not resend the stuck Unichain packet or unlock custody on a timeout — it may still deliver and create two live representations
Leaving LayerZero DVN/executor on defaults delegates security to whoever the defaults name (KelpDAO April 2026 was a 1-of-1 DVN)
Unichain Sepolia deployment uses a non-canonical ERC-6551 registry (0x4609...), so account addresses differ from canonical
The utility branch's source is an opaque xz patch applied by CI with push rights; read the decompressed patch (hashes verified) before trusting it
Commons byte limits count UTF-8 bytes not characters; invitation-only circles are not private; moderation/withdrawal are tombstones, not deletion
